encounter.title: Prologue Boss — Square Candidate B (7x7 seed 98)

phases.label: moved to North (↑): Rotate granted, interrupt cast!

encounter.notes: LD-003 square shortlist candidate B. 7x7 seed 98 (11 arrows: N2 E4 S3 W2). Compact tutorial scale. Phase 1 consumes all 4 E arrows. Phase 2 needs 5 N hits (only 2 exist on board). Rotate CW converts W arrows into N arrows for a clean 0-damage kill. Rotate CCW converts the empty E side to N, leaving player stranded and taking 2 damage.
